lede: Third batch of this feature, from R2: the New Year rows with the phone's date inside the New Year window (REQ-006), build 2611231 installed with adb, Stage. Most entries are the filed Christmas bugs (P0254–P0275) repeating on the New Year screens: those tickets name the Christmas sale only, so each is a new entry naming its related ticket. New: ISS-XMA-26 (Back needs two presses), ISS-XMA-30 (title art language), ISS-XMA-35 (Mine pill countdown), ISS-XMA-40 (countdown on the Christmas credit page).

why.ISS-XMA-26: New on 2611231: R1 on 2611201 closed with one Back.
why.ISS-XMA-30: New Year art only: the Christmas art was translated.
why.ISS-XMA-34: 57 vs 58 in all 27 languages; the rows failed on other items too.
why.ISS-XMA-39: The footer and 「unused credits」 stay with held ISS-XMA-20.
why.ISS-XMA-40: Ruling Q-11: countdown on New Year only.
